commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A cross from a corner kick by Almeria is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+4' A lofted cross from Abner (Betis) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' That's the end of the game for Lucas Robertone, who is replaced by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria).
84' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Pablo Fornals is replaced by Rodri (Betis).
84' Juan Miranda comes off the pitch to be replaced by Abner (Betis).
81' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Substitution. Leo Baptistao is replaced by Luis Suarez (Almeria).
79' Here is a change. Marc Pubill is going off and Pepe Mel gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
77' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is easily saved by Luis Maximiano.
77' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
75' Today's match ends for Ayoze Perez who will be replaced by Nabil Fekir (Betis).
73' The attendance is 48622.
69' Chumi (Almeria) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Alejandro Ruiz sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
67' The Almeria players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
66' 3 - 2 Goal! 3:2. Luka Romero (Almeria) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
66' Luka Romero (Almeria) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
65' Here comes a substitution. Luka Romero (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Choco Lozano.
64' 3 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Ayoze Perez (Betis), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 3:1.
60' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Johnny Cardoso will be replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
60' It's time for a substitution. William Carvalho (Betis) comes on in place of Willian Jose.
58' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' Juan Miranda (Betis) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.

56' Betis slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
54' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
49' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
47' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
46' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
46' Referee Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+2' 2 - 1 Superb finishing from Leo Baptistao (Almeria). Marc Pubill plays a fantastic through ball and finds Leo Baptistao (Almeria), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a close-range shot past the goalkeeper. It's 2:1.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' Isco (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' Marcos Pena (Almeria) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
38' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:2.
35' Marc Pubill (Almeria) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
33' Chadi Riad (Betis) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
31' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
28' 2 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Isco (Betis) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:0.
26' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
24' Isco (Betis) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
21' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
17' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
15' Ayoze Perez (Betis) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
13' Willian Jose (Betis) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Luis Maximiano thwarts him with a nice save.
10' Isco (Betis) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Pablo Fornals (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
7' Isco (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Wonderful movement by Betis. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Isco (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

The players are out at last! Almeria will take the kick-off.
